steps.text: Beat margarine and shortening together in a large bowl until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla extract.
Gradually beat in confectioners’ sugar, alternating with milk, until frosting is smooth, light, and spreadable.

raw_recipe.headline: Simple Butter Cream Frosting
raw_recipe.description: This quick and easy buttercream frosting is made with margarine and shortening for the classic bakery-style flavor and texture.
raw_recipe.name: Simple Butter Cream Frosting

recipeInstructions.text: Beat margarine and shortening together in a large bowl until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla extract.
Gradually beat in confectioners’ sugar, alternating with milk, until frosting is smooth, light, and spreadable.

review.reviewBody: This is by far the best frosting I have ever had! I made it with butter and butter flavor Crisco and I used whole milk for a more creamy frosting. I have never had so many compliments and it's so simple to make. It's so versatile that I made a double batch and used part to frost a cake and then we frosted sugar cookies. I do recommend making sure that you are beating it long enough so as to eliminate lumps of any kind and if your powdered sugar is lumpy, I would sift it before adding to the mixture. All and all- a most excellent recipe!

So for those saying it tastes like the supermarket frosting let me help you out. Use plain full fat yogurt,Greek yogurt or even butter milk instead of the milk I promise you'll thank me later it gets rid of that undescribable taste. Something about the tart in the yogurt that balances the flavor. Also whatever extract you use consider finding a flavored yogurt that pairs. My cakes have been a hit this way. You will have to refrigerate the frosting and let it rest if you aren't frosting and serving right away..
Sweet fluffy bakery quality frosting. I substituted margarine with real butter and milk for half and half. Use a KitchenAid if you have one; much easier to whip ingredients!

It came out great but I used whole milk and butter flavored Crisco and instead of margarine I used real butter . It came out sweet creamy and very good. I then added some orange food coloring for the Halloween cupcakes I was making.

I'm giving it four stars because I think it's a good recipe but I like my frosting "not so sweet". I made it with 2 3/4 cups powdered sugar and it was even still a little sweet for my tastes but still very good. I also used a butter flavored shortening for extra butter flavor. I loved how easy it was to spread and I will go to this recipe from now on except I will use half or less of powdered sugar from now on.

This worked well for me. I didn't' have margarine so I subbed vegetable spread (country crock) which worked but had a slightly different taste then most likely margarine would have. I added 6 T of unsweetened cocoa powder to frost my sons birthday cake & that seemed to mask the Country crock taste a bit. Overall very good, and helped this mom when in a bind. Thanks!

I love this icing!! It is the only one i use...especially the chocolate version someone else suggested (replace 1 cup sugar with cocoa and increase milk by 1/4 cup). I have constant requests for the icing with or without cake to put it on.

I used butter instead of margarine and 3 cups of confectioners sugar instead of 5. It was plenty sweet. I probably should have beat it longer than 4-5 minutes because it was a wee bit gritty. I was hoping that the frosting was going to be light and airy but it seemed dense like what you get out of a store bought can. I will try again and maybe tweak the beating time in hopes that it gets lighter.
I love this frosting. So light and fluffy if you beat it on high for a minute. I like to add a 1/4 teaspoon of almond flavoring for another touch of richness sometimes.

Frosting was the best I’ve ever made. Not the best I’ve ever had. But couldn’t tell you what the secret ingredient was in that one. I substituted good butter for margarine and used banana extract instead of vanilla and it was delicious. Will never buy frosting again.
It came out great! I added strawberry purée instead of the milk for a strawberry flavored buttercream!
I made this exactly like it was! I was in a hurry and needed something quick. This was a perfect amount for a 13 x 9 inch pan, with a generous amount of frosting.
MADE MY OWN B'DAY CAKE TODAY AND USED THIS SUPER TASTING RECIPE. I DID USE ALMOND EXTRACT DUE TO THE FACT THE CAKE WAS ALMOND WHITE CAKE. I WILL BE USING THIS AGAIN, FOR SURE.
It was so good. I put butter in instead of margarine and shortening and it tasted great. I am definitely going to do this again.
Save your true buttercream for special cakes - this recipe is perfect for frosting cheap Betty Crocker cupcakes! It even piped really well.
Made exactly as the recipe and it turned out great. Good taste and good spreadability.
Very easy and tasty. Will be my go to recipe.
Light and fluffy buttercream. The only difference I made was I did 3/4 butter and only 1/4 shorting

After carefully following the recipe, I was very disappointed. The stuff would stick to anything - except the cake! Next time I'll look for a little thinner frosting. Maybe that'll do it. It did taste good.
Was very easy to work with. Tasted buttery but hardened with the Crisco. Will use again.
